official_definition: (Can't Stack) At the end of the battle which you used any Magic card, return a "Golden Cloud" family Spirit card/Magic card from your Trash to the Hand.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Heavenly Light] or [Heavenly Light: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Heavenly Light]", "give [Heavenly Light]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
